content.title: Portable ice rink rental questions
content.subtitle: These answers help event planners understand what to prepare before requesting pricing.

items.question: What types of events can use a portable ice rink?
items.answer: Portable ice rinks can support holiday activations, corporate events, schools, municipalities, shopping centers, festivals, and private venues when the space and logistics are suitable.

items.question: Can a rink be installed indoors or outdoors?
items.answer: Yes. Indoor and outdoor options depend on the surface, available footprint, access, protection needs, power, weather exposure, and event operations plan.

items.question: What information is needed for a quote?
items.answer: Helpful details include event date, venue address, indoor or outdoor location, available dimensions, expected attendance, schedule, surface type, access notes, and support needs.

items.question: Do you provide skates, barriers, and event support?
items.answer: Skates, barriers, skate aids, benches, staffing, signage, lighting, and related support can be reviewed as part of the quote planning process.

items.question: How far in advance should we request pricing?
items.answer: Earlier is better, especially for holiday events and seasonal activations. Share event details as soon as the venue and target date are known.
